source: Visit San Antonio 2026–27 holiday lights guide

guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around San Antonio this season, with 2026 dates checked against the organizers and local guides.

items.name: River Walk Holiday Lights
items.blurb: More than 200,000 lights in the cypress trees over the river. Free to stroll; river cruises cost extra.
items.blurbEs: Más de 200,000 luces en los cipreses sobre el río. Pasear es gratis; los paseos en barco cuestan aparte.

items.name: Zoo Lights
items.addr: 3903 N St Mary's St, San Antonio, TX 78212
items.blurb: The zoo lit up with light displays and holiday music.
items.blurbEs: El zoológico iluminado con luces y música navideña.

items.name: Illuminate
items.blurb: Glowing trails of handcrafted lanterns and large light sculptures.
items.blurbEs: Senderos con faroles artesanales y grandes esculturas de luz.

items.name: Holidays on Houston Street
items.blurb: Nearly 400,000 mini lights on about 80 trees, plus giant ornaments and wreaths downtown.
items.blurbEs: Casi 400,000 luces en unos 80 árboles, con adornos gigantes y coronas en el centro.

items.name: Pearl Holiday Tree Lighting
items.blurb: Carolers, hot chocolate and river barge rides as Pearl lights its tree.
items.blurbEs: Villancicos, chocolate caliente y paseos en barcaza mientras Pearl enciende su árbol.

items.name: Holiday in the Park
items.blurb: Light displays, rides and holiday shows, with New Year's Eve fireworks.
items.blurbEs: Luces, juegos y espectáculos navideños, con fuegos artificiales en Año Nuevo.
